title: Build your own promise
description: Idris's nightly price list at Ashgrove Press waits for the paper count and the press queue, and one night it printed half a list and nobody could say why, so Hesper says the waiting code goes unless someone at the shop can explain every line of it. You write the shop a small promise of its own, the docket: three states, then, chains, errors and catch, callbacks that always run later, all and race. By the end you know what happens each time you write then or await.

parts.title: Errors, order and many at once
